listings.title: Data Structures and Algorithms in C++
listings.author: Adam Drozdek
listings.subject: Computer Science
listings.description: Well-maintained Data Structures and Algorithms textbook, ideal for CSE students preparing for semester exams. Minimal markings, tight binding, and full coverage of arrays, linked lists, trees and graphs.

listings.title: Operating System Concepts
listings.author: Silberschatz, Galvin
listings.subject: Computer Science
listings.description: Barely used copy of the classic operating systems text. Covers processes, scheduling, deadlocks, memory management and file systems. No highlighting anywhere.

listings.title: Computer Networks
listings.author: Andrew S. Tanenbaum
listings.subject: Computer Science
listings.description: Standard networking textbook used across the CSE syllabus. Light highlighting in the transport layer chapters, otherwise clean. Covers OSI, TCP/IP, routing and network security.

listings.title: Database System Concepts
listings.author: Korth, Sudarshan
listings.subject: Computer Science
listings.description: Complete DBMS reference with SQL, normalisation, indexing and transaction management. Great for both semester exams and placement prep.

listings.title: Machine Learning
listings.author: Tom M. Mitchell
listings.subject: Computer Science
listings.description: Foundational machine learning text covering decision trees, neural networks, Bayesian learning and reinforcement learning. Some pencil notes in the margins.

listings.title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
listings.author: Russell & Norvig
listings.subject: Computer Science
listings.description: The standard AI textbook. Search, knowledge representation, planning, probabilistic reasoning and learning, all in near-perfect condition.

listings.title: Higher Engineering Mathematics
listings.author: B.S. Grewal
listings.subject: Mathematics
listings.description: The engineering mathematics book every first year needs. Calculus, differential equations, linear algebra and transforms with hundreds of solved problems.

listings.title: Java: The Complete Reference
listings.author: Herbert Schildt
listings.subject: Computer Science
listings.description: Practically untouched copy. Full Java language reference plus collections, threads, JDBC and Swing. Ideal for OOPs coursework and interview prep.

listings.title: Web Development with HTML, CSS and JavaScript
listings.author: Jon Duckett
listings.subject: Computer Science
listings.description: Beautifully illustrated front-end book. Clean pages, no markings. Covers HTML, CSS, responsive layout and modern JavaScript basics.

listings.title: Digital Design and Computer Architecture
listings.author: Harris & Harris
listings.subject: Electronics
listings.description: Digital electronics and computer organisation in one book. Logic gates, combinational and sequential circuits, MIPS architecture and pipelining.

listings.title: Introduction to Algorithms
listings.author: Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest, Stein
listings.subject: Computer Science
listings.description: CLRS, the reference every placement aspirant keeps. Sorting, graph algorithms, dynamic programming and NP-completeness. Spine intact, no torn pages.

listings.title: Engineering Physics
listings.author: H.K. Malik, A.K. Singh
listings.subject: Physics
listings.description: Used but complete first-year physics text. Some cover wear and notes in the margins, all pages present. Optics, quantum mechanics, lasers and semiconductors.
